```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-validation-summary
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-validation-summary`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): see rename_legacy_antibiotic_table() in
# this report's _setup.qmd. A dataset serialized before neoipcr 0.0.0.9002
# carries no validation summary at all, and one built with the validation
# pass switched off carries an empty one; a sentence says which, for the
# department's data and for the reference data alike, instead of failing the
# render.
validation_strings <- sR$`tbl-validation-summary`
validation_shown <- compared_summaries(
  own = benchmark_data$validationSummary$own,
  ref = benchmark_data$validationSummary$ref,
  has_reference = "ref" %in% benchmark_data$dataset_names,
  own_notes = c(
    absent = validation_strings$own_not_available,
    empty  = validation_strings$own_pass_not_run),
  reference_notes = c(
    absent = validation_strings$reference_not_available,
    empty  = validation_strings$reference_pass_not_run),
  zero_notes = c(
    own       = validation_strings$own_no_removals,
    reference = validation_strings$reference_no_removals,
    both      = validation_strings$both_no_removals),
  sR = sR)
validation_notes <- validation_shown$notes
if (length(validation_shown$summaries) == 0L) {
  # No dataset has a summary to show: the department's sentence takes the
  # table's place, and the reference data's follows it.
  no_data_table(validation_notes[1])
  validation_notes <- validation_notes[-1]
} else {
  tbl <- format_validation_summary_table(
    validation_shown$summaries, sR, font_size = summary_table_font_size)
  if (is.null(tbl)) no_data_table(validation_shown$zero_note) else tbl
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# A dataset without a summary of its own contributes no column group; the
# reader is told why rather than left to wonder.
for (note in validation_notes)
  cat("\n", note, "\n", sep = "")
```
